description.undefined: OWL-DL ontology modelling the EUDAMED registry: medical devices, manufacturers, identified risks, reported incidents and field safety corrective actions (FSCAs).

comments.undefined: Ontology for the European catalogue of high-risk medical devices and in vitro diagnostic devices, under MDR (EU 2017/745) and IVDR (EU 2017/746) regulatory frameworks.
